Call for Posters

The ISSAC 2007 Poster Sessions are an ideal venue for presenting recent research results or ongoing research projects that might not yet be complete, but whose preliminary results are already interesting nonetheless. Posters on all conference topics are welcome.

Important Dates

Submission deadline: June 5, 2007 (Midnight [24:00 EDT]) but late submissions will be consider (see here for details)

Submission Instructions

Authors are invited to submit an extended abstract of no more than 2 pages (A4 or letter) describing the contents of the poster. Abstracts of posters will be distributed at the symposium. PDF and PS formats are preferred. For posters, A0 format is preferable but not mandatory.

Helpful Links

Authors are encouraged to visit the following sites for information on poster preparation:

  • SIAM Guidelines for poster preparation
  • How to produce A0 posters in Latex
  • Using xfig to create your poster
  • Making a Poster Using LaTeX and Xfig
